_why: Every flow that erp_compliance.py --all MUST audit. Without this, --all audits whatever happens to be in this directory and reports 'all N flows comply' on a subset - which is exactly how WF-E and WF-B went four days with no circuit breaker deployed while --all stayed green. A missing export is now a FAILURE that names the flow, not silence.
_how: Export with get_workflow_details and write the .workflow object to exports/<slug>.json. Matching is on the workflow id, not the filename.
_export_field: How each export got here, because it changes what a green run means. 'api' = the n8n MCP returned the workflow to a file and it was copied verbatim. 'transcribed' = the MCP returned it INLINE (small workflows are not auto-saved) and no n8n API credential exists in this environment, so it was copied by hand from that response. A transcribed export is faithful-but-manual: it can be WRONG in a way a stale one cannot. Three things bound that - tools/export_report.py diffed against the live fetch, its --check-js pass over every Code node body, and the breaker byte-compare - and none of them proves the bytes match. Re-export any transcribed flow the moment a real API route exists.
